paper: Phased One-Step Adversarial Equilibrium for Video Diffusion Models

source.example: Realistic style, scene 8: snow-covered forest with forward camera movement

verified_claims.single_step: The official gallery labels this specific snow-forest clip V-PAE-1NFE. The paper describes V-PAE as a single-step distillation framework.
verified_claims.speed_context: Paper Table 1 and Section 4.2 compare V-PAE 1-NFE against a 100-NFE Wan2.1-I2V-14B baseline and report 100× diffusion acceleration. This quantitative ratio is deliberately not printed on the cover, and no same-scene 100-NFE forest video is claimed.

cover.layout: Large 1 STEP cue in a compact left diagram area; monochrome schematic noise and one arrow point into the dominant original forest result. No top strip, promotional slogan or dense diagram.
cover.source_image_processing: FFmpeg extracts the original frame at 1.0 second; SVG uses an aspect-preserving centered crop for the forest panel. No generated-result pixels are retouched.
cover.schematic_noise: Native SVG feTurbulence with fixed seed 13, grayscale and contrast. This is an illustrative input-noise symbol, not a measured or recorded latent tensor, baseline output, or scientific result.
cover.alt: Schematic noise-to-result path labeled 1 STEP beside an official V-PAE snow-forest video frame.

video.edit: Existing continuous official snow-forest result retained. Scale and FPS sampling only; native playback speed, no interpolation, no fabricated result, no animated schematic.
video.aria_label: Phased OAE: an official one-step video result moving through a sunlit snowy forest at original speed.

candidate_review: Reviewed official realistic rainy-window and tiger V-PAE/APT 1-NFE pairs. Both use the same evaluation count, so they do not communicate the reduction to one step as clearly. Direct 100-NFE Wan comparisons on the page use painted musicians or the previous queen portrait. The forest plus an explicit one-step sampling schematic better fits the requested visual direction without inventing a matched baseline.
proof: Reviewed in CUA Chromium at full size and at 200×112.5 pixels. Screenshot is proof.jpg in the external onestep review directory.
